app.name: Nitor
window.title: Monitor
tooltip.refresh: Read the current values from the monitor
error.ddcutil.title: ddcutil is not installed
error.ddcutil.body: Nitor talks to your monitor through ddcutil. Install it with your package manager, for example: sudo dnf install ddcutil
error.monitor.title: No DDC/CI monitor found
error.monitor.body: Make sure DDC/CI is enabled in the monitor's on-screen display and that the display is connected with DisplayPort or HDMI.
error.ddc.title: Could not talk to the monitor
error.ddc.body: The monitor did not answer the DDC/CI request. Try reconnecting the cable or restarting the session.
hint.mode_lock: If brightness or contrast does not change, leave sRGB or Movie mode on the monitor's own menu (use Games or User mode).
action.title: Are you sure?
action.body: This resets monitor settings and cannot be undone from the computer.
about.comments: A small, focused monitor control panel built with GTK 4 and libadwaita. It exposes every standard DDC/CI feature your monitor reports.
confirm.blank.title: Turn the screen off?
confirm.blank.body: The monitor will go dark. Press a key or use its power button to wake it.
confirm.power.title: Power off the display?
confirm.power.body: The monitor will switch off. Use its power button to turn it back on.
preset.title: Presets
preset.save_subtitle: Creates a preset from the current monitor state
settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_hide_desc: The panel closes when it loses focus, like a HUD
settings.debounce_desc: Milliseconds to wait before sending a value to the monitor
error.locked: {feature} is locked in this picture mode
settings.check_updates_desc: Asks GitHub once a day for a newer release
settings.diagnostics_desc: Version, monitor and system details for bug reports
